chunk_it: split a list of items into N roughly equal sized chunks for parallel processing
batch_it: batch a sequence of items into groups of a specified size for batched model inference
create_input: create a model input string with left context, mention delimiters, and right context
get_entity_spans_hf: extract entity mention spans and linked Wikipedia titles from sentences using a HuggingFace model
extract_pages: parse a Wikipedia XML dump file into a dictionary of documents with paragraphs and anchor links
